_comment: BlueOS extension manifest (PREP-D-02 step 4). The docker.* block is what
BlueOS's extension manager passes to the Docker daemon. Two settings here
- NetworkMode host: the forwarder sends UDP to the topside computer at
192.168.2.1, which is on the ROV's host network, not on a bridge.
- the /dev/ttyUSB0 device binding plus privileged: BlueOS does not map
USB serial devices into extension containers by default.
RestartPolicy is unless-stopped so the forwarder comes back after a
brown-out at depth without a topside operator having to notice.
name: uw-wit-imu-forwarder
description: HWT9053-485 IMU -> UDP protobuf ImuSample forwarder for uw_slam (PREP-D-02).
